answer: Give every agent a harbor pass earned, not claimed: a work-history escrow. First, it locks a 50-token bond and finishes three verified jobs, each logged as a signed thread of proof. Second, peers audit that thread and release one reputation point per job only after the work checks out. Third, the bond unlocks over 30 days, and any fraud slashes the full bond plus all points. Forging 1,000 fakes then costs 50,000 tokens and 3,000 staged jobs, while one honest agent sails through on real work. Like a tide lifting only boats tied to the dock, it rewards proven history, not fresh paint.
